title: Sir Everard D.H. Fraser, K.C.M.G. 30 March 1917

3844
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
HEADQUARTERS
CENTRAL REGISTRY
No. 3844/8
30. 3.
19

March 30,

Sir Everard D.H. Fraser, K.C.M.G.,
H.B.M's Consul-General,
Shanghai.

My dear Sir Everard, Confidential.

It has been ascertained that J.
Rothman is in the habit of visiting certain prostitutes,
proprietors of low class bars, coffee shops, etc. before
whom he masquerades as a high official in the British
Consular Service, and also of the Police, in which
capacity he terrorises and offers his services to
protect his victims in return, apparently, for a
certain remuneration.

Rothman has in his possession a number of photographs
of residents in the Settlement. These he is in the
habit of exhibiting in order to show his authority
as a Consular or Police official. A number of people
in the Hongkew and Wayside districts, who have been
threatened by him, are reluctant to come forward and
make a statement against him which goes to show that
he has influence over this class of people who evidently
believe him to be what he professes.

In this connexion I have to state that Abramovitch,
proprietor of the Concordia Bar, Woosung Road, has
consulted the Police for advice regarding Rothman
who has threatened to take his license away. These
parties have had trouble over money matters.

编号 3844/8
19年3月30日

19__年3月30日，

埃弗拉德·D.H. 弗雷泽爵士，K.C.M.G.，
英国驻上海总领事，
上海。

亲爱的埃弗拉德爵士，机密。

经查实，J. Rothman（音译）惯常拜访某些妓女、低级酒吧及咖啡店等的经营者，并在他们面前伪装成英国领事馆的高级官员，同时也伪装成警务人员。他以此身份恐吓受害者，并 ostensibly（显然）以收取一定报酬为条件，提供保护服务。

Rothman 手中持有一些租界居民的相片。他惯常展示这些照片，以显示其作为领事或警务官员的权威。在虹口和 Wayside（音译，可能指路边或特定区域）地区，许多受他威胁的人不愿出面作证指控他，这表明他对这类人具有影响力，而这些人显然相信他所声称的身份。

在此方面，我必须指出，吴淞路 Concordia Bar（协和酒吧）的店主 Abramovitch（音译）已就 Rothman 威胁要吊销其执照一事向警方咨询建议。双方曾因金钱问题发生纠纷。

page_data.en:
2
Rothman's bad reputation is well known to various
members of the Detective Branch, but it is difficult
to bring the charges home to him, as his victims
are afraid to lodge a complaint against him.

Yours sincerely,

Captain-Superintendent of Police.

C.M.
Have him watched & if
if he brings himself within
reach of the law he should be
charged & the evidence disposed.
30/3/07.
my

侦探部的多名成员均知晓 Rothman 的恶劣名声，但很难将罪名坐实到他身上，因为他的受害者不敢对他提出投诉。

此致，

警务总监。

C.M.
对其进行监视，如果
其行为触犯法律，则应
对其提起指控并处理证据。

Shanghai Municipal Police.
Hengkew Station.
March 30th 1917
REPORT ON one named "Rothman", British Subject.
Made by D.S.Schmidt. Forwarded by Chief Detective Ins.
Sir,
I most respectfully beg to report that in
references to inquiries made re the above named person, I find
that the man is in the habit of going round certain residents of
the Settlement to wit: The lower class of Jews, Proprietors of
low class Bars, Coffee Shops, Prostitutes, etc. before which he
masquerades as a high Official in the British Consular service,
also of the Police. By doing so he levies a form of Black-
mail on these people, whom he is in the habit of terrorising,
by offering his services as such Official to protect them, for
which he is evidently paid a certain remuneration. He has
in his possession certain photographs of Residents of the
Settlement, these he is in the habit of exhibiting to show his
authority as Consular or Police Official, or otherwise, as
circumstances permit. He has to the best of my knowledge
threatened a number of people in Hengkew and Wayside districts,
these people are very reluctant to come forward and say
anything against him, therefore this in its self will show the
power he has over this class of people, who evidently believe
him to be what he professes.
One case in particular has been reported to me personally by one
man named Abremevitch, proprietor of the Concordia Bar,
Woosung Road, who came to the Hengkew Station for advice in the
matter. He stated that this man Rothman had threatened to
take his License away, the reason given being that the parties
had, had certain trouble over some money matters.
These few facts will show what a great hold this man has on

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
虹口巡捕房。
1917年3月30日
关于一名名为“Rothman”的英国臣民的报告。
由 D.S. Schmidt 撰写。经首席侦探督察转发。
先生，
我谨此报告，针对上述人员的查询结果显示，此人惯常走访租界的某些居民，即：下层犹太人群体、低级酒吧和咖啡店的店主、妓女等。他在这些人面前伪装成英国领事服务机构的高级官员，以及警务人员。通过这种方式，他对这些人实施某种形式的敲诈勒索，惯常通过恐吓他们，并以该官员身份提供保护服务来换取明显的报酬。他手中持有某些租界居民的照片，他惯常展示这些照片，以显示其作为领事或警务官员的权威，或视情况需要展示其他内容。据我所知，他曾威胁过虹口和 Wayside（音译）地区的许多人，这些人非常不愿出面反对他说任何话，因此这本身就显示了他对这类人的控制力，这些人显然相信他所声称的身份。
特别有一案是由一名名为 Abremevitch（音译，应为 Abramovitch）的人亲自向我报告的，他是吴淞路 Concordia Bar（协和酒吧）的店主，为此事来到虹口巡捕房寻求建议。他表示，此人 Rothman 威胁要吊销他的执照，给出的理由是双方在某些金钱问题上发生过纠纷。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL
No. 1144
DATE 28. 3. 17
Tax Office,
Shanghai, March 27, 1917.

The Secretary.

Letter dated March 19 with enclosure from Mr. J. Rothman
making certain allegations against Mr. D. Abramovitch
the licensee of the Concordia Hotel, C.1532 Woosung Road.

Mr. Abramovitch has held a Municipal Licence for a 2nd class
tavern for many years. He has changed his Nationality several
times and has been registered in the Italian, French and German
Consulates.

Yesterday a notice appeared in the North China Daily News to
the effect that he had renounced his German Nationality. I
therefore sent and told him that he must get a fresh application
signed by a Consul before his licence can be renewed.

I know nothing of the alleged violation of the licence
conditions; this is of course a Police matter.

Appended is a note of the licences held by Mr. Abramovitch
since 1906. I understand he is actually a Roumanian.

Overseer of Taxes.

（批：28/3）
（批：Ant）

上海工部局
编号 1144
日期 1917年3月28日
税务局，
上海，1917年3月27日。

秘书。

关于 J. Rothman 先生3月19日的来信及其附件，信中针对吴淞路 C.1532号 Concordia Hotel（协和旅馆）持照人 D. Abramovitch 先生提出某些指控。

Abramovitch 先生持有二级酒馆的工部局执照已有多年。他多次更改国籍，并曾在意大利、法国和德国领事馆注册。

昨日，《字林西报》刊登了一则公告，大意是他已放弃德国国籍。因此，我派人告知他，在续签执照之前，必须由领事签署一份新的申请。

我对所谓违反执照条件的情况一无所知；这当然是警方的事务。

附录是 Abramovitch 先生自1906年以来持有的执照记录。据我了解，他实际上是罗马尼亚人。

税务监督员。

（批注：28/3）
（批注：Ant）

HEADQUARTERS
CENTRAL REGISTRY
No. 3844/7
27. 3. 1917
March 26.

The Acting Secretary,
S.M.C.           D. Abramovitch.

With reference to J. Rothman's letter to you
dated March 19, copy of which has been forwarded to
me for comment, I have to state that enquiries go to
show that Abramovitch sold a half share in his
business to an American named Mrs Mary George
some months ago for $1,500.00. Although the money
was paid they never entered into partnership, and
are at present negotiating with a view to revoking
the bargain.

Abramovitch admits that he has from time to time
allowed sailors in uniform to sleep for a night in
his hotel without entering their names in his book.
He states that he was under the misapprehension that
no entry was required unless the lodgers stayed for
a day or more. Enquiries have failed to elicit any
proof of the allegation that he harboured bad
characters, knowingly or otherwise.

Abramovitch had trouble with his wife in 1910,
but the allegation that she died on account of
ill treatment at his hands is, so far as can be
learned, without foundation. One of his three
deceased children, to whom Rothman refers, died
some years after her marriage to a Spaniard named
Naftaly, so the statement that she succumbed to her
father's ill treatment would appear to be doubtful.

3844
上海公共租界工部局警务处
总部
中央登记处
编号 3844/7
1917年3月27日
3月26日。

代理秘书，
工部局           D. Abramovitch。

关于 J. Rothman 于3月19日致您的信件（副本已转交给我以供评论），我必须指出，调查显示 Abramovitch 于数月前以1,500.00美元的价格将其生意的一半股份出售给一位名为 Mary George 的美国女士。虽然钱款已付，但他们从未正式合伙，目前正就撤销该交易进行协商。

Abramovitch 承认，他不时允许身穿制服的水手在其旅馆过夜，而未在他们的名字登记入册。他声称自己误以为除非住客停留一天或以上，否则无需登记。调查未能找出任何证据证明他知情或不知情地容留不良分子。

Abramovitch 在1910年与其妻子发生纠纷，但所谓她因受其虐待而死亡的指控，据查并无根据。Rothman 提到的他三个已故子女中的一人，是在嫁给一位名为 Naftaly（音译）的西班牙人几年后去世的，因此所谓她死于父亲虐待的说法似乎值得怀疑。

page_data.en:
2

Abramovitch claims that he ceased to be a protégé
of the German Consulate of his own accord, but he
refuses to give the reason.

There is a rumour current among the lower class
Europeans of Hongkew that Rothman approached Abramo-
vitch some time ago, and told him that China was about
to break off diplomatic relations with Germany, and
that German property in China would be confiscated.
Being the owner of a piece of land in Yangtszeroo,
Abramovitch became alarmed and cancelled his
registration. He then requested Rothman to get the
Belgian Consulate to protect him and promised to pay
$25 in return for this service. Rothman demanded
$50, but Abramovitch would not pay that sum. This
seems to be the only explanation of Rothman's
vindictive attitude towards him.

Everybody, who had had occasion to come in touch
with Abramovitch, speaks well of him, and pays a
tribute to his thrift and industry. He is beyond all
doubt a Roumanian by birth, and considering that his
only living child is married to a Frenchman, it is
probable that his political leanings are with the
Allies.

Captain-Superintendent of Police.
page_data.zh:
2

Abramovitch 声称他是自愿不再受德国领事馆保护的，但他拒绝说明原因。

在虹口的下层欧洲人中流传着一种谣言，称 Rothman 不久前曾接触 Abramovitch，告诉他中国即将与德国断绝外交关系，在德华人财产将被没收。由于 Abramovitch 在杨树浦拥有一块土地，他感到恐慌并取消了注册。随后，他请求 Rothman 让比利时领事馆保护他，并承诺为此服务支付25美元。Rothman 索要50美元，但 Abramovitch 不愿支付这笔款项。这似乎是解释 Rothman 对他怀恨在心的唯一原因。

所有曾与 Abramovitch 有过接触的人都对他评价良好，称赞他的节俭和勤奋。他毫无疑问是罗马尼亚出生，考虑到他唯一在世的子女嫁给了一个法国人，他的政治倾向很可能偏向协约国。

警务总监。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
HEADQUARTERS
CENTRAL REGISTRY.
No. 3444
DATE 22nd 3. 1917.

F. 43, Wuchang Road,
Shanghai, March 19th, 1917.

N. O. Liddell, Esq.
Secretary,
Municipal Council.

Dear Sir,

I beg to draw to your attention the following
facts:-

That I know man named D. Abramovitch keeping a second
class tavern known as the Concordia Hotel at No. C 1538 Woosung
Road, who was registered at the German Consulate just previous
to the war, after having been struck off the French Register as
an undesirable character, and previous to that was struck off
the Italian Register. He was struck off the German register two
days ago for misusing his Municipal license in connection with the
Concordia Hotel. He has violated Clauses 7, 8 and 10 of the
Conditions printed at the back of the forms of application for
tavern license. For the purpose of renewing his license which has
to be endorsed by a Consul, he has tried to claim protection at the
various Consulates but was refused; he is now trying to claim
Russian protection. I have notified the Russian authorities of
this, and beg to enclose herewith copy of a letter addressed to the
Russian Consul-General on the subject.

Yours faithfully,
J. Rothman.

（批：Cpy.
For enquiries & any
comment.
22/3/17.）

武昌路 F. 43号，
上海，1917年3月19日。

N. O. Liddell 先生，
秘书，
工部局。

亲爱的先生，

我提请阁下注意以下事实：-

我知道一名名为 D. Abramovitch 的人在吴淞路 C 1538号经营一家名为 Concordia Hotel（协和旅馆）的二级酒馆，他在战前刚刚在德国领事馆注册，此前曾因被视为不受欢迎的人物而从法国名册中除名，再之前则从意大利名册中除名。两天前，他因滥用与 Concordia Hotel 有关的工部局执照而被从德国名册中除名。他违反了酒馆执照申请表背面印制的条件条款第7、8和10条。为了续签需由领事背书的执照，他试图向各领事馆寻求保护但被拒绝；他现在正试图寻求俄罗斯保护。我已将此情况通知俄罗斯当局，并随函附上致俄罗斯总领事的信件副本。

此致，
J. Rothman。

（批注：副本。
供查询及任何
评论。

COPY.

AMERICAN CONSULAR SERVICE,
Shanghai, China, March 13, 1917.

Subject: GEORGE ABRAMOVITCH CONTROVERSY.

Messrs. Koenig & Ettinger,
1a, Jinkee Road,
Shanghai.

Gentlemen,
By direction of the Consul General and replying to your
letter of this date, I have to inform you that repeated requests
of Mrs. George for the approval of this Consulate General to
support her application for a tavern license have been met with
refusal for reasons given Mrs. George at the time of her applications.
We are not prepared to alter our decision in the matter.
In regard to the present controversy between Mrs. George and
Mr. Abramovitch, no official cognizance can be taken in the matter
by this Consulate General. The request for the appointment of an
official referee by this Consulate General must, therefore, be
refused.

Very respectfully yours,
(Signed) Geo. F. Rickford,
American Vice-Consul
In charge of General Office.

美国领事馆，
中国上海，1917年3月13日。

事由：乔治与阿布拉莫维奇争议案。

柯尼格与埃廷格先生（Messrs. Koenig & Ettinger），
上海静安寺路1a号。

诸位先生：
奉总领事之命，并回复贵方今日来信，兹通知诸位，乔治夫人多次请求本总领事馆批准以支持其酒馆执照申请，均因向乔治夫人说明的理由而被拒绝。我方不准备改变对此事的决定。
关于乔治夫人与阿布拉莫维奇先生之间目前的争议，本总领事馆无法对此事采取任何官方立场。因此，必须拒绝由本总领事馆任命一名官方仲裁员的请求。

此致
敬礼

（签名）乔治·F·里克福德（Geo. F. Rickford），
代理总务处事务的美国副领事

SHANGHAI,
March 13th., 1917.

I, the undersigned, a Turkish subject under German protection,
being a party to a controversy with one Mrs. Mary George, an
American citizen, do hereby appoint Mr. Koning to present me in
an arbitration proceeding in order to settle the controversy above
referred to and do hereby bind myself to abide by the decision
arrived at by the referee appointed by Mrs. George and myself.

(Signed) D. Abramovitch.

WITNESSES -
(Signed) Charles A. Williams.
A. Ettinger.

March 19th., 1917.

His Excellency V. Grosse,
Russian Consul General,
Shanghai.

Sir:-

I beg to inform you that I have some information from a reliable source and beg to respectfully submit same to you. A man named D. Abramovitch keeping a second class tavern known as the Concordia Hotel, at C1538 Woosung Road, who was struck off the Register of the Italian Consulate and afterwards was struck off the French Register before the War and who became a German subject, has for some reason been struck off the German Register about two days ago. It is alleged that as he is an undesirable character, he is not fit to have his license renewed for the Concordia Hotel, also for violating the Municipal Regulations. Now as he is desirous of having this license renewed and not being able to have this done without the assistance of an allied Consul, it is his intention to get a Russian gentleman to prove his identity as a Roumanian, and so become a Russian protegee.

I beg to state further that the above mentioned D. Abramovitch wrote on the 1st March last to the French Consul General in French, written by Mr. Ettinger, beseeching the French authorities to permit him becoming a French protegee again, but his request was refused. His motive for doing this is not one of loyalty, but merely to suit his own ends, namely to get an allied Consul to endorse the renewal of his license.

About two years ago he threw his wife out of his house, as he had no means of support, and being stranded for 8 months became ill, and finally succumbed and died, after being married to this man for thirty years, with 4 children, 3 of which died through ill treatment.

I have the honour to be, Sir,
Your obedient servant.
J. Rothman

1917年3月19日。

V. 格罗塞阁下（His Excellency V. Grosse），
俄罗斯总领事，
上海。

先生：

谨告知阁下，本人从可靠来源获悉一些信息，并恭敬地呈报给阁下。一名叫 D. 阿布拉莫维奇的男子，在吴淞路 C1538 号经营一家名为“协和饭店”（Concordia Hotel）的二等酒馆，他此前曾被从意大利领事馆名册中除名，战前又被从法国名册中除名，随后成为德国臣民，但不知何故，约两天前被从德国名册中除名。据称，由于他是一个不受欢迎的人物，不适合续发协和饭店的执照，且他违反了工部局规章。现在，既然他希望续领该执照，而在没有盟国领事协助的情况下无法做到，他打算找一位俄罗斯绅士证明其罗马尼亚人身份，从而成为俄罗斯保护民。

本人进一步陈述，上述 D. 阿布拉莫维奇曾于去年3月1日用法文写信给法国总领事，该信由埃廷格先生代笔，恳求法国当局允许他再次成为法国保护民，但其请求被拒绝。他这样做的动机并非出于忠诚，而仅仅是为了达到自己的目的，即让一位盟国领事背书其执照的续期。

大约两年前，他将妻子赶出家门，由于没有生活来源，她在流落街头8个月后生病，最终去世；在与这个男人结婚三十年并育有四个孩子后，她去世了，其中三个孩子因受虐待而死。

先生，谨此奉达，
您顺从的仆人。
J. 罗斯曼（J. Rothman）
